author: T. P. Gifford
title: Tom Oliverson highlights legislative priorities and commitment to conservative values in recent posts
text:
Tom Oliverson, M.D., a Republican member of the Texas State House representing the 130th district since 2017, has recently used his social media platform to highlight legislative initiatives and personal priorities.
On June 22, 2026, Oliverson posted, “Proud to offer this 340B model act at @NCOILorg. Join us in Boston for the discussion! https://t.co/hxoO0UTrd6” .
The following day, on June 23, he drew attention to his published opinion piece, “Check out my op-Ed in The Washington Times on why our Charity Care Legislation is must pass next session! https://t.co/LhPIlrwRfa – @washtimesoped” .
On June 24, Oliverson reiterated his political values and ongoing commitments, “The values that built Texas are worth protecting. I remain committed to defending our freedoms, strengthening families and advancing conservative policies that promote economic opportunity, educational excellence and safer communities. Learn more about my work and priorities: https://t.co/DC2ZTMzOvs” .
Oliverson was elected to the Texas State House in 2017 after succeeding Allen Fletcher as representative for District 130. Since then, he has focused on issues such as healthcare policy and conservative governance within Texas.
